verdict.rationale: Azure documents a first-party Cost Management API that supports querying cost and usage data through multidimensional analysis, with custom filters and expressions about Azure resources. That covers the queryable billing/cost API core of the story. The pack contains no evidence of scheduled cost exports, and per-resource granularity is only implied. missing for 10: documented scheduled/recurring cost exports, explicit resource-level granularity in cost data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analyst, cost data is queryable — a billing/cost API and scheduled exports with resource-level granularity, not just a dashboard screenshot

citations.quote: The Cost Management APIs provide the ability to explore cost and usage data via multidimensional analysis, where creating customized filters and expressions allow you to answer consumption-related questions for your Azure resources.
